name: Romania
spiritual_teacher: Hesychasm / Carpathian sketes (Sacred silence tradition, ancient Transylvanian monasteries, yoga communities)
work_strategy: Hybrid / Remote (1% SRL micro-enterprise tax or 10% PFA, full DTT protection, TP status)
it_market: Good (One of Eastern Europe's strongest IT hubs: Bucharest, Cluj-Napoca, Iași, Timișoara)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days 0 €; then Z015 + Formular 212: CASS 10% + PIT 10% = 114–143 € (≤750 €), but at ≥12 MW, CAS 25% (194.71 €) is added → 327–365 €/mo.

price_sources.summary: [Numbeo Romania](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/country_result.jsp?country=Romania); heating/utilities — `CLIMATE_AND_HEATING_COSTS.md`; food — Lidl / Kaufland / Mega Image; rent parser — `~/Public/travel-helper/src/domains/housing/housing-normalizer.ts`.
numbeo_mandatory_fields: Estimated monthly costs for a single person without rent (food, transport, basic household)
Basic utilities (Electricity, Heating, Cooling, Water, Garbage) + Internet (Broadband)

climate: *Constanța (sea):* annual mean +12.5°C; winter +4...-2°C (windy); summer +27...+18°C. Heating season 4.5 mos (~80–120 €/mo).
*Brașov (Carpathians):* annual mean +8.5°C; winter +1...-8°C (deep snow, frost); summer +24...+12°C. Heating season 6 mos (gas/wood ~120–180 €/mo).
*Conclusion:* Constanța saves up to 300–400 € per heating season compared to mountainous Brașov.
nature: Top Mountains and Forests (Carpathians, old-growth Transylvanian conifer forests, gorges, Black Sea in Constanța)
english_level: Easy (Very high English proficiency among youth and in services, top-15 globally per EF EPI)
housing_rent: Very cheap. **Constanța (sea coast):** great option with low off-season rent (from ~250–320 € for a 1-bed); in Brașov (Carpathians) and Iași ~280–350 €; developed rental market without strict screening.
citizenship: 8 years (Standard naturalization with language and constitution exam)
mortgage_expats: Moderate (Available for tax residents via the Noua Casă program and commercial banks)
rent_to_buy: Rare (Închiriere cu opțiune de cumpărare occasionally found in new residential complexes)

protection_and_aid_2026.entry_documents: Any document proving Ukrainian citizenship (birth certificate for children). Biometric passport required for air travel.
protection_and_aid_2026.protection_status: Temporary protection (Permis de ședere) until March 4, 2027. A personal numeric code (CNP) is assigned.
protection_and_aid_2026.military_liable_rule_2026: **From 31.07.2026, EU countries do not grant protection to conscription-liable persons without proof of legal exit and deferral.**
protection_and_aid_2026.social_benefits: No direct state cash benefits. International aid available for vulnerable groups: UNHCR (568 RON/mo per person, 3 months) and Red Cross (110 €/mo, 3 months). Child state allowance (alocație) — 277 to 683 RON.
protection_and_aid_2026.housing_aid: 6 state temporary accommodation centers (Bucharest, Suceava, Maramureș, etc.). Rentals via unacoperis.ro or the 50/20 program (payments directly to Ukrainians).
protection_and_aid_2026.healthcare: Free emergency medical care and treatment of acute conditions. Full free care for the first 90 days on biometric entry. Free prenatal care and pediatrics.
protection_and_aid_2026.transport: Public transport is paid for everyone.
protection_and_aid_2026.work_rights: Automatic right to work. Can work under a qualification declaration without diplomas (except medicine, architecture, law).

items: [Imobiliare.ro](https://www.imobiliare.ro/inchirieri-apartamente) — largest and most popular real estate portal with city filters (Constanța, Brașov, Bucharest).
[Storia.ro](https://www.storia.ro/) — modern aggregator from owners and agencies (powered by OLX).
[OLX.ro](https://www.olx.ro/imobiliare/apartamente-garsoniere-de-inchiriat/) — direct listings from owners with no agency fee.
[Publi24.ro](https://www.publi24.ro/anunturi/imobiliare/de-inchiriat/) — popular classifieds for finding cheap rentals and rooms.
[Rentola.ro](https://rentola.ro/en) — international search engine for verified housing.
[Flatio.com](https://www.flatio.com/i/apartments-for-rent-romania) — monthly furnished rentals with utilities included and no deposit.
[Unacoperis.ro](https://unacoperis.ro/uk) — dedicated volunteer housing search platform for Ukrainians.

notes: **Strict conditions:** income of `600 / 750 / 800 / 1 000 €/mo` net after UA FOP Group 3 (5% single tax + 1% military levy + SSC); without opening a local PFA/SRL; horizon >1 year factoring in deferral.
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.legality_over_183d_with_deferral: Covered by **EU Council Decision 2026/1912** (TP until 04.03.2027); conscription-age men need proof of legal exit and deferral/exemption. Without TP, Digital Nomad visa requires ~3,700+ €/mo (unavailable).
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.forms_after_183d: *Legea 227/2015, Art. 7 pct. 28* — **Z015** questionnaire (within 30 days) + **Declarația Unică (Formular 212)** by May 25 as *activități independente* from abroad.
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.dtt_ua_ro: Ukrainian 5% single tax is **not credited** by ANAF against local 10% PIT.
anaf_thresholds_2026: **6 MW** (`24,300 RON/yr` ≈ `389 €/mo`): minimum base for **10% CASS**.
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.verdict: Only viable as a **6-month transitional option** (or strictly at income ≤750 €). At 800–1,000 €, the 12 MW threshold makes official relocation with UA FOP economically unviable.
